content:
ana: Quick heads up 10am call with BetaSys. They want a rate-card override: 40% off seats for first 3 months + 300k token commit for trial. CPQ didn't surface 'special_approval' so the flow dropped. Need quick routing so AE can commit on the call.

patrick: Can you paste opp id and current CPQ snapshot? We can try a manual DD route.

ana: opp id 0071G00001BzRt2. CPQ line items show `commit_band` = "250-499k" but the `special_approval` checkbox is false.

oliver: 40% is above discount cap. Standard auto rule: discount <=30% auto; >30% -> deal desk + finance. Also commit tiers >=250k require legal review for usage SLAs. This will need multi-approval.

ana: Ugh. Is there a way to toggle routing from Slack or a short API call? We're mid-demo.

patrick: Use the Dealflow API endpoint to force route: POST /dealflow/route with payload {opportunity, reason, forced=true}. I'll run it.

dealflow-bot: Received forced routing request for opp 0071G00001BzRt2. Created ticket DF-9402. Assigned to oliver. SLA: initial ack in 2 business hours (expedite flag set).

oliver: I'm on it. To save time, can AE accept a counter: 32% discount for first 3 months + commit 300k, and a capped overage clause instead of unlimited burst? Finance tends to accept if effective rate per token > minimum floor.

ana: AE says BetaSys will push back if not 40%. They need clear yes/no now.

oliver: I'll ping finance directly. Also, legal needs to confirm the trial addendum covers token overages; otherwise we can't guarantee SLA.

finance: Reviewed DF-9402. Immediate decision: cannot approve 40% at commit 300k without CRO sign-off. Counter-offer prepared: 32% limited to Q1 usage, revenue commit recognized up-front, include 60-day review clause.

oliver: Adding finance decision to ticket, tagging legal for addendum. Also changed CPQ fields: set `special_approval=true`, `approved_discount=32`, `approval_ticket=DF-9402`.

dealflow-bot: DF-9402 updated -> finance counter-offer recorded; status pending legal. ETA legal: 6 business hours.

ana: On the demo, AE communicated the 32% counter and 60-day review. BetaSys asked if we can auto-route similar future deals when commit>=300k and AE role=enterprise to fast-track to CRO for day-of approvals.

patrick: That's a product ask. I'll file ENG-CPQ-511 to add an "expedite_to_CRO" flag and make `special_approval` required when discount>30 or commit_band >= 300k.

oliver: For now, if BetaSys signs the counter, legal will finish addendum and finance will finalize. If they insist 40%, escalate to CRO with packaged economics.

dealflow-bot: DF-9402 final note: "Counter-offer 32% accepted by customer provisional (sales note). Awaiting signed addendum. If customer requests 40% escalate to CRO." Ticket closed by oliver.

ana: Thanks everyone. Filing a quick retro so CPQ won't hide `special_approval` again. :thumbsup:
